values.note: Seven of the 12 sites are reservable on recreation.gov and five are first-come; recreation.gov's rate table runs a 'First-come, First-served Season' from October 1 to November 30. Occupy the site within 24 hours of the reservation's start or it may be forfeited. Run by the Forest Service (Mio Ranger District), not a concessionaire.

note: Huron NF campground (Mio Ranger District) on shallow, sandy-bottomed Wagner Lake in mixed hardwood forest, 1 mile west of M-33 on Wagner Lake Road: beach play and swimming, carry-in canoes and kayaks, good bass and panfish fishing. Reportedly a dirt access road and a narrow, hilly interior loop with tight curves - a 23-ft rig fits, bigger rigs struggle. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov + RIDB catalog: $15 (confirmed, 2027), Senior/Access 50% (stated on the FS page), no electric/water hookups (confirmed), 12 sites (confirmed) with back-in driveways to 70 ft (new), vault toilets + hand-pump water (confirmed), season May 1 - Nov 30 (new, FS 'Seasons of Use'), reservable on recreation.gov (confirmed) with 5 first-come sites and a first-come season Oct-Nov, 14-night max (new). FS-run, no concessionaire. Phone (Mio RD 989-826-3252) matches. FS page 'Site Open'; forest alerts list no closure for Wagner Lake Road (the March 2026 winter-storm 'know before you go' covers the Mio district generally). Note trimmed of field restatements; access road length corrected to recreation.gov's 1 mile.
